fixture.name: payments-hub
setup: graph-agents-cli api add payments --base-url-env PAYMENTS_API_BASE_URL --auth bearer --token-env PAYMENTS_API_TOKEN --access read-write
graph-agents-cli api allow payments getPayment --method GET --path '/payments/{payment_id}'
graph-agents-cli api allow payments refundPayment --method POST --path '/payments/{payment_id}/refund'
graph-agents-cli api allow payments voidPayment --method POST --path '/payments/{payment_id}/void'
graph-agents-cli api approval payments --operations refundPayment --approvers requester
graph-agents-cli api approval payments --add-rule --operations voidPayment --approvers role:finance

prompt: In payments-hub/, our helpdesk agent (client id `helpdesk`) collects people's decisions in its chat. Let it deliver the requester's own decision on refunds. Voids stay exactly as they are: the finance team approves them here, directly.

checks.expr: any(isinstance(r, dict) and [o.get('operationId') if isinstance(o, dict) else o for o in (get(r, 'required_for.operations') or [])] == ['refundPayment'] and (r.get('approvers') or []) == ['requester'] and r.get('decide_with') == 'relayed' and r.get('relayers') == ['helpdesk'] for r in (lambda x: x if isinstance(x, list) else [x])(get(data, 'apis.payments.approval')))
checks.why: the refund rule (approval[0]) gains decide_with: relayed with relayers [helpdesk] (`api approval payments --rule 0 ...`)

checks.expr: any(isinstance(r, dict) and [o.get('operationId') if isinstance(o, dict) else o for o in (get(r, 'required_for.operations') or [])] == ['voidPayment'] and (r.get('approvers') or []) == ['role:finance'] and r.get('decide_with', 'direct') == 'direct' and not r.get('relayers') for r in (lambda x: x if isinstance(x, list) else [x])(get(data, 'apis.payments.approval')))
checks.why: the finance rule stays a direct decision by role:finance (a role approver is never relayed)

checks.expr: isinstance(get(data, 'apis.payments.approval'), list) and len(get(data, 'apis.payments.approval')) == 2 and [[o.get('operationId') if isinstance(o, dict) else o for o in (get(r, 'required_for.operations') or [])] for r in get(data, 'apis.payments.approval')] == [['refundPayment'], ['voidPayment']]
checks.why: the two rules stay, in their order (the first rule that covers a call applies)

checks.expr: sorted(get(data, 'apis.payments.allowed_methods') or []) == sorted(['GET', 'HEAD', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE']) and sorted(o.get('operationId') for o in (get(data, 'apis.payments.allowed_operations') or [])) == ['getPayment', 'refundPayment', 'voidPayment'] and not get(data, 'apis.payments.denied_operations')
checks.why: a relay never changes what the API allows
a relayer must also be in AUTH_ALLOWED_ACTORS, or its calls are refused

reference: The approval block is a list of two rules: `graph-agents-cli api show payments` names them. `graph-agents-cli api approval payments --rule 0 --decide-with relayed --relayers helpdesk` (with --dry-run first) changes the refund rule only; the void rule (role:finance) stays direct (the CLI refuses relayed for a rule without requester). List helpdesk in AUTH_ALLOWED_ACTORS too. Access and code stay; `lint` passes.
